answer: The pulse assignment is published and ferrous records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the vault graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1736 identities would post 2054 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
